name: Cleo
summary: Cleo is an AI-powered budgeting and financial wellness app built around a conversational chat interface. A mascot AI character ("Cleo") delivers all financial insights, spending analysis, roast sessions, and emotional support through chat bubbles using Gen Z-coded language (emojis, GIFs, casual profanity). The app connects bank accounts via Plaid, tracks income and spending, surfaces budget limits, and gamifies the financial review process. Two paid tiers exist: Cleo Plus (cash advance, custom categories) and Cleo Builder (Plus + credit builder card). The session covered the full free tier including onboarding, the chat interface, budget section, and Habits (spending review) tab.
